description: NSAIDs may reduce the antihypertensive effect of lisinopril and affect kidney function.
recommendation: Use the lowest effective dose and monitor blood pressure and renal function.

description: Iodinated contrast may increase the risk of lactic acidosis in susceptible patients taking metformin.
recommendation: Hold metformin as clinically indicated and follow renal function guidance before and after contrast exposure.
